_derivation: The live V2 exchange never emits a maker-SELL OrderFilled (0 of 8,761 logs sampled 2026-07-23 — the USDC leg is always on the maker side; SELLs surface via the taker role). This log is the real buy-maker capture with data words [0]<->[1] and [2]<->[3] swapped, so it decodes to an identical token_id/usdc/shares/price but exercises the decoder's SELL branch. It exists only to guard that branch.
